mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache Eviction Policy

The project's current recorded decision is to use Least Recently Used (LRU) cache eviction, removing the least-recently-used entries when the cache reaches capacity, combined with a fixed time-to-live (TTL) of 300 seconds, after which entries expire regardless of how recently they were accessed.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
